en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a monastery church with a shingled tower set in tall grass and trees, with the Făgăraș Mountains in the background. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, the printed caption naming the site, publisher details, and a Romanian 40 Bani stamp depicting a lizard (Ablepharus kitaibelii). There are Bucharest postmarks and an address written to a recipient in Bucharest.
